Lecture 11.1 - Reasoning in Knowledge Graphs using Embeddings
Jure Leskovec
Computer Science, PhD

In this lecture, we introduce how to perform reasoning over knowledge graphs and provide answers to complex queries. We talk about different possible queries that one can get over a knowledge graph, and how to answer them by traversing over the graph. We also show how incompleteness of knowledge graphs can limit our ability to provide complete answers. We finally talk about how we can solve this problem by generalizing the link prediction task.
